title: lesquerella arctica subsp. purshii
intro: Lesquerella arctica subsp. purshii, commonly known as Pursh's bladderpod, is a subspecies of the Lesquerella arctica plant, a member of the mustard family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Lesquerella arctica subsp. purshii include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which may be useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates and other sulfur-containing compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
